mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.learning_outcomes (id, prefix_number, description, sort_order, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{prefixNumber}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{courseId}, #{groupLearningOutcomeId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.learning_outcomes SET prefix_number = #{prefixNumber}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, course_id = #{courseId}, group_learning_outcome_id = #{groupLearningOutcomeId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, prefix_number, description, sort_order, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.learning_outcomes WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, id

SELECT id, prefix_number, description, sort_order, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.learning_outcomes WHERE group_learning_outcome_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, id

SELECT id, prefix_number, description, sort_order, course_id, group_learning_outcome_id, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.learning_outcomes WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND group_learning_outcome_id IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.learning_outcomes SET group_learning_outcome_id = #{groupId}, prefix_number = #{prefixNumber}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND course_id = #{courseId}
